verdict.rationale: Microsoft Entra ID is a cloud identity service that holds customer and user data, so an AI-training opt-out or a no-training data commitment is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers provisioning, Conditional Access, passkeys, lifecycle workflows, log routing and Graph APIs, but contains nothing about whether customer data is used to train AI models or how to opt out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
